what_changed: FCC announces the compliance date for the one-to-one prior express written consent rule for telemarketing robocalls and robotexts (47 CFR 64.1200(f)(9)): consent must name a single seller and the calls must be logically associated with the website where consent was given.
rationale: Prior express written consent applies to telemarketing and advertising calls only, which the relevance test excludes; servicing and collection calls use prior express consent. The diff confirms the amendment is to the PEWC definition. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
